items.en: Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see [https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode.md) to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization
items.zh: 新增 Code Mode（实验性，需主动启用），在该模式下 Claude 编写 JavaScript 来调用其工具；参见 [https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode.md) 了解如何启用，或如何为组织关闭该功能

items.en: Added `engines["claude-code"]` to `plugin.json`: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits
items.zh: 在 `plugin.json` 中新增 `engines["claude-code"]`：超出所声明 Claude Code 版本范围的 plugin 不会被安装、更新或加载，安装和更新时会选择符合范围的最新版本

items.en: Added type checking of a plugin's TypeScript hooks module to `claude plugin validate`; each finding is a warning, and `--strict` fails on it
items.zh: `claude plugin validate` 新增对 plugin 的 TypeScript hooks 模块的类型检查；每项发现均为警告，使用 `--strict` 时则视为失败

items.en: Added to `claude plugin validate` the `$` nouns a mod's `engine.create` hook adds, withholds or replaces
items.zh: `claude plugin validate` 新增检查 mod 的 `engine.create` hook 所添加、保留或替换的 `$` 名词

items.en: Added support for `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` in managed settings for Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version)
items.zh: 托管设置中新增对 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` 的支持，适用于第三方提供商上的 Claude Desktop session（待 Claude Desktop 包含此版本后生效）

items.en: Added an options menu (stop, switch to usage credits, upgrade) when a model needs usage credits that are turned off or used up
items.zh: 当模型需要已关闭或已用尽的用量额度时，新增选项菜单（停止、切换到用量额度、升级）

items.en: Added a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds while hooks run long in `claude -p` and SDK sessions, so a host such as Claude Desktop won't end the turn as hung (once it includes this version)
items.zh: 在 `claude -p` 和 SDK session 中 hooks 长时间运行时，每 30 秒发送一次进度心跳，避免 Claude Desktop 等宿主将本轮判定为挂起而结束（待其包含此版本后生效）

items.en: Added `.docx` support to Artifact tool asset uploads
items.zh: Artifact 工具的资源上传新增 `.docx` 支持

items.en: Added a `/diff to close` hint to the diff panel, and the keys that focus and close a panel to the `?` shortcut guide
items.zh: diff 面板新增 `/diff to close` 提示，`?` 快捷键指南新增聚焦和关闭面板的按键说明

items.en: Added a start-up warning for Bash allow rules with a `*` in a variable's value, such as `Bash(PORT=* npm run dev)`
items.zh: 对于变量值中含 `*` 的 Bash 允许规则（如 `Bash(PORT=* npm run dev)`），新增启动警告

items.en: Added a warning when a plugin's language server can't start, naming the server and what to check
items.zh: 当 plugin 的语言服务器无法启动时新增警告，指明该服务器及需检查的内容

items.en: Added a one-time startup notice naming `CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE` when Perforce settings are found and the mode is off
items.zh: 当检测到 Perforce 设置且该模式关闭时，新增一次性启动提示，指明 `CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE`

items.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES` (available since 2.1.318): set it to `1` to turn off subagent progress summaries and the requests that write them (anthropics/claude-code#86879)
items.zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES`（自 2.1.318 起可用）：设为 `1` 可关闭 subagent 进度摘要及生成这些摘要的请求（anthropics/claude-code#86879）

items.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_HINT_COMMAND`, which a program that starts Claude Code can set to have the exit hint name its own resume command
items.zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_HINT_COMMAND`，启动 Claude Code 的程序可设置该项，使退出提示显示其自己的恢复命令

items.en: Added `unsetOptionCount` to the `claude plugin install --json` result: how many `userConfig` options are not yet set
items.zh: `claude plugin install --json` 结果新增 `unsetOptionCount`：尚未设置的 `userConfig` 选项数量

items.en: Added `isPromptCovered` to the props a mod's pane is drawn with, telling it when a dialog or a field above the prompt covers the prompt
items.zh: mod 面板绘制时传入的 props 新增 `isPromptCovered`，用于告知其 prompt 上方的对话框或字段何时遮挡了 prompt

items.en: \[VSCode] Added a Claude Code trust prompt before the first session in a folder you haven't trusted; declining leaves the folder's settings and MCP servers unused
items.zh: \[VSCode] 新增 Claude Code 信任提示：在尚未信任的文件夹中首次开启 session 前显示；拒绝后该文件夹的设置和 MCP servers 将不会被使用

items.en: \[VSCode] Added the live output of a running Bash or PowerShell command to the chat, under the command's card
items.zh: \[VSCode] 新增在聊天中显示正在运行的 Bash 或 PowerShell 命令的实时输出，位于该命令的卡片下方

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Added a failure notification when a scheduled task's run can't start because its settings require a sandbox that isn't available where it runs
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 新增失败通知：当计划任务的运行因其设置要求使用沙箱、而运行所在环境不提供沙箱而无法启动时显示

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Added the No repository option to the repository picker for new sessions on a self-hosted environment
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 新增在自托管环境中为新 sessions 选择仓库时提供 No repository 选项

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Added a warning to a cloud session's Delete dialog when deleting it will pause scheduled tasks that run in that session
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 新增在云 session 的删除对话框中显示警告：删除该 session 将暂停在其中运行的计划任务

items.en: \[Remote Control] Added a Try again button to the error shown when the computer running your session is signed out of Claude Code
items.zh: \[Remote Control] 新增 Try again 按钮：当运行你 session 的计算机已退出 Claude Code 登录时，在显示的错误中提供该按钮

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Added Claude Tag sessions started in Slack to the Compliance API on Enterprise plans, in beta: list the sessions and read their transcripts
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 新增在 Enterprise 计划中将 Slack 中启动的 Claude Tag sessions 纳入 Compliance API（beta）：可列出这些 sessions 并读取其对话记录

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Added a confirmation step when an admin turns off Claude Tag for the organization, with a dialog that says what stops
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 新增管理员为组织关闭 Claude Tag 时的确认步骤，弹窗会说明哪些功能将停止

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Added a Retry button to a Slack channel's Configure page for when its settings fail to load
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 新增在 Slack 频道的 Configure 页面中，当设置加载失败时显示 Retry 按钮

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Added a Scope filter to the Network events tab of Claude Tag's Activity page, so admins can download one scope's events instead of the whole organization's
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 新增在 Claude Tag 的 Activity 页面 Network events 标签页中添加 Scope 筛选器，使管理员可以只下载某个 scope 的事件，而非整个组织的事件

items.en: \[Code Review] Added a Download CSV button to Code Review admin settings: export review costs per repository by month, week or day, for one repository, one GitHub organization or all
items.zh: \[Code Review] 新增在 Code Review 管理员设置中添加 Download CSV 按钮：按仓库、按月、周或日导出审查成本，可针对单个仓库、单个 GitHub 组织或全部

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Reverted the exit code of an on-demand runner whose work order was superseded to 1; 2.1.321 and 2.1.322 had changed it to 0
items.zh: 自托管运行器：将工单被取代的按需运行器的退出码恢复为 1；2.1.321 和 2.1.322 曾将其改为 0

items.en: Changed `/security-review` to ask before Claude runs it, and skills' inline git commands to stop in bare-repository worktrees and similar folders until you allow them, outside auto mode and bypass
items.zh: 变更了 `/security-review`，在 Claude 运行前会先询问；并将 skills 中的内联 git 命令改为在裸仓库 worktree 及类似文件夹中暂停，直到你允许，自动模式和 bypass 除外

items.en: Changed how many messages each of your sessions on the same machine can send the others without a prompt from you, from about 20 to 100,000
items.zh: 变更了同一台机器上各 session 之间无需你提示即可互相发送的消息数量，从约 20 条改为 100,000 条

items.en: Changed the number of messages a Claude Desktop Code tab session can send to your other sessions before it waits for you to type again from 20 to 100,000
items.zh: 变更了 Claude Desktop Code 标签页 session 在等待你再次输入之前可向其他 session 发送的消息数量，从 20 条改为 100,000 条

items.en: Changed organization settings and policy requests to no longer use a proxy set only by `ALL_PROXY`; set `HTTPS_PROXY` if your network needs a proxy for them
items.zh: 变更了组织设置和策略请求，不再使用仅由 `ALL_PROXY` 设置的代理；如果你的网络需要代理，请为它们设置 `HTTPS_PROXY`

items.en: Changed the context window assumed for a model ID that Claude Code doesn't recognize from 200K to 1M; use `/autocompact` to compact earlier, or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` to keep 200K
items.zh: 变更了 Claude Code 无法识别的模型 ID 所假定的上下文窗口，从 200K 改为 1M；可用 `/autocompact` 提前压缩，或设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` 保持 200K

items.en: Changed sessions on other vendors' models with a smaller window: once full, they can fail every turn until `/clear`, so set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` before they fill
items.zh: 变更了在其他厂商模型上、窗口更小的 session：一旦填满，可能每一轮都失败直到 `/clear`，因此请在填满前设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1`

items.en: Changed Claude Code's own ripgrep and most internal git commands to run without most of its sign-in tokens and API keys, so a credential helper or hook under such a git command no longer finds them
items.zh: 变更了 Claude Code 自带的 ripgrep 和大多数内部 git 命令，使其在运行时不再携带大部分登录 token 和 API key，因此此类 git 命令下的凭据助手或 hook 不再能找到它们

items.en: Changed `MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1` to run the v2 MCP client in a compatibility mode (earlier handshake, relaxed OAuth sign-in checks), because the v1 MCP client is removed
items.zh: 变更了 `MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1`，改为以兼容模式运行 v2 MCP 客户端（更早的握手、放宽的 OAuth 登录检查），因为 v1 MCP 客户端已被移除

items.en: Changed the tool Claude uses to finish an MCP server sign-in so that it asks you to confirm, even in bypass and auto modes; where nobody can be asked, such as in `dontAsk` mode, use `/mcp`
items.zh: 变更了 Claude 用于完成 MCP 服务器登录的工具，使其会请求你确认，即使在 bypass 和自动模式下也是如此；在无人可询问的场景（如 `dontAsk` 模式）请使用 `/mcp`

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed a session at a connector's approval prompt or sign-in inside a running tool to be released as paused at the idle or lifetime limit; a late answer resumes from a fresh clone
items.zh: 自托管运行器：变更了处于 connector 审批提示或运行中工具内登录的 session，使其在空闲或生命周期上限时以暂停状态释放；迟到的回答会从全新克隆恢复

items.en: Changed artifact updates to ask first, even under an allow rule, when people outside your organization can see the artifact or Claude can't check who can
items.zh: 变更了 artifact 更新，使其会先询问，即使存在允许规则，只要组织外的人能看到该 artifact 或 Claude 无法确认谁能看到

items.en: Changed `glab config set` without `--global` or `--host`, and `glab config edit --local`, to fail read-only inside the Bash sandbox; run them outside it
items.zh: 变更了不带 `--global` 或 `--host` 的 `glab config set` 以及 `glab config edit --local`，使其在 Bash 沙箱内以只读方式失败；请在沙箱外运行它们

items.en: Changed the Bash sandbox on macOS, Linux and WSL to ignore write access granted through a symlink in a writable folder that leads elsewhere or to a missing path; grant the real path instead
items.zh: 变更了 macOS、Linux 和 WSL 上的 Bash 沙箱，使其忽略通过可写文件夹中的符号链接授予的写权限（该链接指向别处或不存在的路径）；请改为授予真实路径

items.en: Changed "don't ask again" so an allow rule that looks like it holds a secret, or would be saved to a `settings.local.json` that git tracks, lasts for the session only and isn't saved
items.zh: 变更了“不再询问”，使看起来包含密钥、或将被保存到 git 跟踪的 `settings.local.json` 的允许规则仅在当前 session 内有效且不会被保存

items.en: Changed the sandbox on macOS and Linux: `git worktree add`, `move` and `remove` now fail read-only, as do commits in a worktree the session wasn't started in or given, even one inside the project
items.zh: 变更了 macOS 和 Linux 上的沙箱：`git worktree add`、`move` 和 `remove` 现在会以只读方式失败，在 session 未启动或未指定的 worktree 中提交也会失败，即使该 worktree 位于项目内

items.en: Changed start-up to stop when a `--settings` file isn't valid JSON and has a `sandbox` key, even one that turns the sandbox off
items.zh: 变更了启动流程，当 `--settings` 文件不是有效 JSON 且包含 `sandbox` 键时停止启动，即使该键会关闭沙箱

items.en: Changed what happens when a tool's permission check fails with an error after a `PreToolUse` hook returned "allow": Claude Code now decides the call as if no hook had answered
items.zh: 变更了 `PreToolUse` hook 返回“allow”后工具权限检查出错时的行为：Claude Code 现在会按没有 hook 应答来处理该调用

items.en: Changed what happens when a tool's permission check fails on input that a `PermissionRequest` hook rewrote: Claude Code now asks again, or refuses the call where nobody can answer
items.zh: 变更了 `PermissionRequest` hook 改写输入后工具权限检查失败时的行为：Claude Code 现在会再次询问，或在无人可应答时拒绝该调用

items.en: Changed the GitLab merge request badge to show only for the repository a sandboxed session opened in
items.zh: 变更了 GitLab 合并请求徽标，使其仅在沙箱 session 所打开的仓库中显示

items.en: Changed the `claude mcp add --help` example to a local command
items.zh: 变更了 `claude mcp add --help` 的示例，改为本地命令

items.en: Changed mods: a `*`, namespace or negated hook on `engine.create` now only observes. To add or withhold a `$` noun, hook `engine.create` by name
items.zh: 变更了 mods：`engine.create` 上的 `*`、命名空间或取反 hook 现在仅作观察。要添加或保留 `$` 名词，请按名称 hook `engine.create`

items.en: Changed `claude plugin validate` to fail a mod whose `engine.create` hook isn't written in the one accepted form; installed mods keep loading
items.zh: 变更 `claude plugin validate`：当 mod 的 `engine.create` hook 未采用唯一被接受的形式编写时，校验将失败；已安装的 mod 仍可继续加载

items.en: Changed marketplace and plugin installs to fail when a git submodule isn't on the commit its repository records
items.zh: 变更 marketplace 和 plugin 安装：当 git 子模块不在其仓库记录的提交上时，安装将失败

items.en: Changed project (`.mcp.json`) MCP server approvals to match the server's exact name; an approval entry written in another spelling now asks again
items.zh: 变更项目（`.mcp.json`）MCP 服务器审批：改为匹配服务器的精确名称；以其他拼写写入的审批条目现在会重新询问

items.en: Changed self-hosted runners under `--trust-workspace false` and VS Code sessions in an untrusted folder: the repository's settings can no longer disable your hooks or turn plugins on or off
items.zh: 变更 `--trust-workspace false` 下的自托管运行器以及不受信任文件夹中的 VS Code session：仓库的设置不再能禁用你的 hooks 或开启、关闭 plugins

items.en: Changed `tool.list` plugin hooks so the tools they add or remove apply to the model and every agent
items.zh: 变更 `tool.list` plugin hooks：其添加或移除的工具现在对模型和每个 agent 生效

items.en: Changed `claude plugin install` and `/plugin` to show a warning instead of success when a plugin's install command writes to stderr
items.zh: 变更 `claude plugin install` 和 `/plugin`：当 plugin 的安装命令向 stderr 写入内容时，显示警告而非成功

items.en: Changed claude.ai chats and Cowork tasks to check a plugin file for secret keys before sending it, and to ask first if it may hold one
items.zh: 变更 claude.ai 聊天和 Cowork 任务：发送 plugin 文件前先检查其中是否含密钥，若可能含有则先询问

items.en: Changed `claude rm` and the agents view to say a session is removed from the list, not deleted; `claude rm` help says the conversation is kept and `claude --resume` lists it
items.zh: 变更 `claude rm` 和 agents 视图：改为说明 session 已从列表中移除，而非已删除；`claude rm` 的帮助说明对话会被保留，并可通过 `claude --resume` 列出

items.en: Changed `/stickers` to say that the sticker pack is all claimed for now, instead of opening a page in the browser
items.zh: 变更 `/stickers`：改为提示贴纸包目前已全部领取完毕，而不再在浏览器中打开页面

items.en: Changed a managed settings `policyHelper` to no longer take environment variables from user or `--settings` files; set what it needs in managed `env` or the launching shell
items.zh: 变更托管设置中的 `policyHelper`：不再从用户文件或 `--settings` 文件获取环境变量；请在托管 `env` 或启动 shell 中设置其所需内容

items.en: Changed a `/skill` or `@file` typed between two files picked in claude.ai or the desktop app, or after a picked file and a link, to no longer take effect
items.zh: 变更在 claude.ai 或桌面应用中两个已选文件之间、或已选文件与链接之后输入的 `/skill` 或 `@file`：不再生效

items.en: Changed split-pane agent teammates to check that requests come from their team lead: one that outlives its lead has its asks refused, and plan approvals must be re-sent after `/clear` or `/resume`
items.zh: 变更分屏 agent 队友：改为校验请求来自其团队负责人；存活时间超过负责人的队友，其请求会被拒绝，且 `/clear` 或 `/resume` 后计划审批必须重新发送

items.en: Changed worktree creation to refuse checkouts whose `.git` folders are links or hold hard links, such as git-new-workdir layouts and `cp -al` copies; use a plain clone
items.zh: 变更 worktree 创建：拒绝 `.git` 文件夹为链接或含硬链接的检出，例如 git-new-workdir 布局和 `cp -al` 副本；请使用普通克隆

items.en: Changed what Claude is told after safeguards stop a forked skill or a workflow agent: retry with a narrower prompt or tell you, instead of doing the work itself
items.zh: 变更防护机制阻止分叉 skill 或 workflow agent 后告知 Claude 的内容：改为用更窄的 prompt 重试或告知你，而非自行完成工作

items.en: Changed browser tool calls (Claude in Chrome, the desktop browser pane) to refuse some escaped or JSON-text inputs and tell Claude how to respell them
items.zh: 变更浏览器工具调用（Chrome 中的 Claude、桌面浏览器面板）：拒绝部分转义或 JSON 文本输入，并告知 Claude 如何重新拼写

items.en: Changed workflows so that a prompt an app marks as not typed no longer reaches their agents as your request
items.zh: 变更 workflow：应用标记为非用户输入的 prompt 不再作为你的请求传给其 agents

items.en: Changed computer use on macOS to refuse key chords that hold Space with Control or Option, and more system shortcuts that need your grant
items.zh: 变更 macOS 上的计算机使用：拒绝按住 Space 加 Control 或 Option 的组合键，以及更多需要你授权的系统快捷键

items.en: Changed first-run setup in Terminal.app to name the "Use Option as Meta key" setting, what Option stops typing, and how to undo it before you agree
items.zh: 变更 Terminal.app 中的首次运行设置：在征得你同意前，说明“Use Option as Meta key”设置、Option 会停止输入哪些内容，以及如何撤销

items.en: Changed the maximum of `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` from 64000 to 300000
items.zh: 变更 `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` 的最大值，从 64000 改为 300000

items.en: Changed workflows in the desktop app's Code tab to pause at a usage limit and continue after it resets
items.zh: 变更桌面应用 Code 标签页中的 workflow：遇到用量限制时暂停，并在重置后继续

items.en: Changed the spend limit and 1M context errors, and `/usage-credits`, in cloud sessions and under Remote Control: they no longer give a web address
items.zh: 变更了云 session 和远程控制下的支出限额、1M 上下文错误以及 `/usage-credits`：它们不再给出网址

items.en: Changed which MCP servers are reported by name in OpenTelemetry exports to follow the current connector directory
items.zh: 变更了 OpenTelemetry 导出中按名称报告的 MCP 服务器，使其遵循当前 connector 目录

items.en: Changed `/logout` in a background session, which had no effect: it now signs out every session on the computer, deletes stored MCP logins and plugin secrets, and ends the session, as in a terminal
items.zh: 变更了后台 session 中的 `/logout`（此前无效）：现在它会退出该计算机上的所有 session，删除已存储的 MCP 登录信息和 plugin 密钥，并结束该 session，与终端中一致

items.en: macOS: Changed the Bash sandbox so `lsof` and similar tools may show less about processes a command did not start
items.zh: macOS：变更了 Bash 沙箱，使 `lsof` 及类似工具对命令未启动的进程可能显示更少信息

items.en: Changed cloud scheduled tasks: a `PostToolUse` hook from your own settings can no longer replace the plan in `ExitPlanMode`'s result
items.zh: 变更了云端定时任务：来自你自己设置的 `PostToolUse` hook 不能再替换 `ExitPlanMode` 结果中的计划

items.en: Changed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` in Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions to stop applying to auto-memory extraction and, in some sessions, to `/btw`; the main conversation still follows it
items.zh: 变更了 Anthropic 托管的云 session 中的 `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE`，使其不再作用于自动记忆提取，并在部分 session 中不再作用于 `/btw`；主对话仍遵循该设置

items.en: Removed the `subagentStatusLine` setting: subagent rows always use the default look, and settings files that still hold the key load as before
items.zh: 移除了 `subagentStatusLine` 设置：subagent 行始终使用默认外观，仍保留该键的设置文件照常加载

items.en: Deprecated a plugin's `agent` setting: it still applies, and now warns at startup, in `claude plugin list` and in `claude plugin validate`
items.zh: 弃用了 plugin 的 `agent` 设置：该设置仍然生效，但现在会在启动时、`claude plugin list` 和 `claude plugin validate` 中发出警告

items.en: \[VSCode] Changed opening a Claude Code on the web session in a folder where Claude Code's sandbox is on: the extension no longer switches to the session's branch for you, and the dialog says why
items.zh: \[VSCode] 变更在 Claude Code 沙箱已开启的文件夹中打开 Claude Code on the web session 的行为：扩展不再自动切换到该 session 的分支，对话框会说明原因

items.en: Improved sign-in errors in `/login` and `claude setup-token` for a rejected, unreachable or timed-out request: they now say what happened and what to check
items.zh: 改进了 `/login` 和 `claude setup-token` 中针对请求被拒绝、无法访问或超时的登录错误：现在会说明发生了什么以及需要检查什么

items.en: Improved Bash permission checks so the same command more reliably gets the same answer on a slow or busy machine
items.zh: 改进了 Bash 权限检查，使同一命令在缓慢或繁忙的机器上更可靠地得到相同结果

items.en: Improved Bash permission checks: some commands that could run differently from how they were checked now ask for permission
items.zh: 改进了 Bash 权限检查：部分命令的实际运行方式可能与检查时不同，现在会请求权限

items.en: Improved `/mcp` to show how many of a server's tools were left out because the API would reject their input schema, and why
items.zh: 改进了 `/mcp`，现在会显示因 API 会拒绝其输入 schema 而遗漏了多少个服务器的工具，以及原因

items.en: Improved the "Not now" choice when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session: it now says when they load
items.zh: 改进了 Claude Code 询问是否启用其在 session 中编写的 mod 时的“Not now”选项：现在会说明它们何时加载

items.en: Improved the error for an MCP tool call whose connector ID is mistyped by a character or two: for a server that the host application registered, it now names the tool to call
items.zh: 改进了 MCP 工具调用中 connector ID 拼错一两个字符时的错误提示：对于宿主应用注册的服务器，现在会指出应调用的工具

items.en: Improved Claude Desktop and cloud sessions for claude.ai accounts with more than 2,000 plugins turned on: a shorter wait at startup, and Claude can now say why plugins are missing
items.zh: 改进了启用了超过 2,000 个 plugin 的 claude.ai 账户在 Claude Desktop 和云 session 中的体验：启动等待更短，Claude 现在可以说明 plugin 缺失的原因

items.en: Improved memory use with many subagents: a finished subagent's transcript is freed sooner instead of staying in memory while later subagents run
items.zh: 改进了存在大量 subagent 时的内存占用：已完成的 subagent 的对话记录会更早释放，而不是在后续 subagent 运行期间一直留在内存中

items.en: Improved installing with the install script: the latest version is no longer downloaded twice
items.zh: 改进了使用安装脚本进行安装的流程：不再重复下载最新版本

items.en: Improved WebFetch speed and memory use on deeply nested pages
items.zh: 改进了 WebFetch 在深层嵌套页面上的速度和内存占用

items.en: Improved the `cleanupPeriodDays` cleanup to count folders it can't read as errors
items.zh: 改进了 `cleanupPeriodDays` 清理，将无法读取的文件夹计为错误

items.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's `/v1/models` to state `max_input_tokens` for models whose context window is certain on every upstream
items.zh: 改进了 Claude 应用网关的 `/v1/models`，对于在所有上游的上下文窗口都确定的模型，现在会标明 `max_input_tokens`

items.en: Improved `ToolSearch` to say when a tool Claude searched for by its short name is already available, instead of only reporting no match
items.zh: 改进了 `ToolSearch`：当 Claude 按短名称搜索的工具已可用时，现在会予以说明，而不是仅报告无匹配

items.en: Improved start-up on Linux when `/home` is an autofs map: Claude Code no longer looks up files in `/home` itself. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS` for a map root deeper than one folder below `/`
items.zh: 改进了 Linux 上 `/home` 为 autofs 映射时的启动：Claude Code 不再在 `/home` 本身中查找文件。对于位于 `/` 下一层以上目录的映射根，请设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS`

items.en: Improved the Fable limit message in `-p`, SDK, IDE and cloud sessions: it now says when the limit resets, along with how to continue
items.zh: 改进了 `-p`、SDK、IDE 和云 session 中的 Fable 限制消息：现在会说明限制何时重置以及如何继续

items.en: \[VSCode] Improved sign-in errors behind TLS-inspecting proxies: a certificate failure now says what to do, as the terminal does
items.zh: \[VSCode] 改进在 TLS 检查代理后的登录错误：证书失败时现在会像终端一样说明该如何处理

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Improved the message when a file fails to upload to a cloud or Remote Control session: it now gives the reason, such as too many pages, a password or a time-out
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 改进文件上传到云或 Remote Control session 失败时的提示：现在会给出原因，例如页面过多、需要密码或超时

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Improved adding a repository Claude can't access to a cloud session: a short message and a Reconnect GitHub button replace the long error
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 改进向云 session 添加 Claude 无法访问的仓库时的体验：用简短提示和 Reconnect GitHub 按钮替代冗长的错误信息

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Improved the message when some network secrets can't be added to a new cloud environment: it lists each host, says why where it can, and stays until you dismiss it
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 改进部分网络密钥无法添加到新云环境时的提示：会列出每个主机，尽可能说明原因，并保持显示直到你关闭

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Improved the new-session repository picker when GitHub single sign-on hides organizations: it now says so even with other repositories listed, and links to reconnect GitHub
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 改进新 session 的仓库选择器在 GitHub 单点登录隐藏组织时的表现：即使已列出其他仓库也会说明该情况，并提供重新连接 GitHub 的链接

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Improved the Git providers page when your GitHub sign-in has expired: it now asks you to reconnect instead of silently hiding organizations you can link
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 改进 GitHub 登录已过期时 Git providers 页面的表现：现在会提示你重新连接，而不是静默隐藏可关联的组织

items.en: Fixed running `/compact` again, or after a command such as `/context`, summarizing away a message that Claude had not answered yet
items.zh: 修复再次运行 `/compact`，或在 `/context` 等命令之后运行时，将 Claude 尚未回复的消息摘要掉的问题

items.en: Fixed a resumed session joining your next message to an old interrupted message that was not resumed
items.zh: 修复恢复的 session 将你的下一条消息拼接到未恢复的旧中断消息上的问题

items.en: Fixed a memory spike at the next prompt after Claude changed a very large file
items.zh: 修复 Claude 修改超大文件后，在下一次 prompt 时出现内存峰值的问题

items.en: Fixed a setting saved in a running session undoing a hand edit made to `settings.json` moments earlier; a settings file you delete during a session now stays deleted
items.zh: 修复在运行中的 session 里保存设置会撤销片刻前对 `settings.json` 的手动编辑的问题；在 session 期间删除的设置文件现在会保持删除状态

items.en: Fixed `claude plugin` commands and `claude mcp list` signing you out of a Console profile when they ended while the token was being renewed
items.zh: 修复了 `claude plugin` 命令和 `claude mcp list` 在 token 续期期间结束时，会将你从 Console 配置文件登出的问题

items.en: Fixed Edit and Bash running out of memory on certain `/proc` files, and Edit hanging or running out of memory on devices and named pipes
items.zh: 修复了 Edit 和 Bash 在特定 `/proc` 文件上内存耗尽的问题，以及 Edit 在设备和命名管道上挂起或内存耗尽的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude Code failing to start, or to clear stored credentials at sign-out, when saving its configuration file failed with "Out of memory"
items.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 在保存配置文件失败并报“Out of memory”时，无法启动或无法在登出时清除已存储凭据的问题

items.en: Fixed requests sent without streaming failing on errors that streamed requests recover from, such as a rejected image, thinking block or beta header
items.zh: 修复了非流式请求在流式请求可恢复的错误上失败的问题，例如被拒绝的图片、thinking 块或 beta 请求头

items.en: Fixed `ExitWorktree`, the worktree exit dialog and `/resume` leaving the session in the wrong folder when the folder the shell was in before entering the worktree had been deleted
items.zh: 修复了 `ExitWorktree`、worktree 退出对话框和 `/resume` 在进入 worktree 前 shell 所在文件夹已被删除时，使 session 停留在错误文件夹的问题

items.en: Fixed accents and other combining marks sometimes landing left of the text, leaving stale copies on screen, or silently disappearing when text wraps
items.zh: 修复了重音符号及其他组合标记有时出现在文本左侧、在屏幕上留下残留副本，或在文本换行时悄然消失的问题

items.en: Fixed the last key of a key chord, such as Enter in ctrl+x enter, acting on a dialog's text field when the chord's own action isn't available there
items.zh: 修复了组合键的最后一个按键（例如 ctrl+x enter 中的 Enter）在对话框自身操作不可用时，作用于对话框文本字段的问题

items.en: Fixed `ps` processes piling up when the process listing Claude Code runs before stopping a command takes too long
items.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 在停止命令前运行的进程列表耗时过长时，`ps` 进程堆积的问题

items.en: Fixed subagent transcripts and large tool results being saved apart from the session's transcript after entering a worktree created by a `WorktreeCreate` hook or belonging to a nested repository
items.zh: 修复了进入由 `WorktreeCreate` hook 创建的 worktree 或属于嵌套仓库的 worktree 后，subagent 记录和大型工具结果与 session 记录分开保存的问题

items.en: Fixed a session on a named Anthropic profile moving to another sign-in when `/fork`, the Left arrow or `--bg` continued it in the background; reopen any session that was open during the update
items.zh: 修复了使用命名 Anthropic 配置文件的 session 在 `/fork`、左箭头或 `--bg` 于后台继续时切换到其他登录方式的问题；请重新打开更新期间处于打开状态的任何 session

items.en: Fixed a background session sending a conversation under another sign-in when its named Anthropic profile is missing, changed or overridden; it now stops and says so
items.zh: 修复了后台 session 在其命名 Anthropic 配置文件缺失、变更或被覆盖时，以其他登录方式发送对话的问题；现在会停止并给出提示

items.en: Fixed a session on an API key, auth token or workload identity from its shell (not a setup token) moving to another sign-in in the background; it now stops and says so
items.zh: 修复了使用来自其 shell 的 API key、auth token 或工作负载身份（而非 setup token）的 session 在后台切换到其他登录方式的问题；现在会停止并给出提示

items.en: Fixed MCP tool calls ending in the sign-in server's error, such as `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, instead of asking you to sign in again
items.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具调用以登录服务器的错误（例如 `TOKEN_EXPIRED`）结束，而非提示你重新登录的问题

items.en: Fixed an expired claude.ai login showing "Credit balance too low" when a saved Console key or `ant auth login` profile without credit was used instead
items.zh: 修复了 claude.ai 登录过期时，在使用已保存的 Console key 或无额度的 `ant auth login` 配置文件的情况下，显示“Credit balance too low”的问题

items.en: Fixed a session on a named Anthropic profile being handed to an older background service that could not keep its sign-in; it now says to restart the service
items.zh: 修复了使用命名 Anthropic 配置文件的 session 被交给无法保持其登录状态的旧版后台服务的问题；现在会提示重启该服务

items.en: Fixed a background session's sign-in leaving the previous account's login or other credentials in place; it now clears them for every session on the computer, and a refused sign-in can leave no login
items.zh: 修复了后台 session 登录后仍保留上一账户的登录或其他凭据的问题；现在会为计算机上的每个 session 清除这些凭据，且被拒绝的登录不会留下任何登录状态

items.en: Fixed background sessions moving between a profile and the stored login when an update restarted them
items.zh: 修复了后台 session 在更新重启时于配置文件和已存储登录之间切换的问题

items.en: Fixed sessions opened before a sign-in keeping signed-out feature flags after the sign-in
items.zh: 修复了登录前打开的 session 在登录后仍保留已登出状态的功能标志的问题

items.en: Fixed sessions that kept failing after a Claude apps gateway sign-in expired: once you sign in again with `/login` in another terminal, they carry on at the next message
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用网关登录过期后持续失败的 session：在另一个终端中用 `/login` 重新登录后，它们会在下一条消息时继续运行

items.en: Fixed the billing notice naming your `ant auth login` organization when a custom `X-Api-Key` header is set
items.zh: 修复了设置自定义 `X-Api-Key` 请求头时，计费通知显示你的 `ant auth login` 组织的问题

items.en: macOS: Fixed "Not logged in · Please run /login" coming back right after a successful `/login` or a token refresh when the keychain was slow to answer
items.zh: macOS：修复了 `/login` 成功或 token 刷新后，因钥匙串响应缓慢而立即重新出现“Not logged in · Please run /login”的问题

items.en: Fixed turns failing in Claude Desktop when an organization's gateway answers an expired token with 403: Claude Code now asks Desktop for a fresh token and retries
items.zh: 修复了组织的网关以 403 响应过期 token 时，Claude Desktop 中的对话轮次失败的问题：Claude Code 现在会向 Desktop 请求新 token 并重试

items.en: Fixed the error shown when Amazon Bedrock refuses your account a model: it no longer says to refresh your AWS credentials, it says to enable the model
items.zh: 修复了 Amazon Bedrock 拒绝为你的账户提供某个模型时显示的错误：不再提示刷新 AWS 凭证，而是提示启用该模型

items.en: Fixed the `awsAuthRefresh` or `gcpAuthRefresh` command sometimes running twice for one request when three or more sessions needed a fresh sign-in at once
items.zh: 修复了三个或更多 session 同时需要重新登录时，`awsAuthRefresh` 或 `gcpAuthRefresh` 命令有时会针对同一请求运行两次的问题

items.en: Fixed the `claude -p` warning about an ended claude.ai login to say that `claude auth logout` also removes saved MCP server logins and plugin secrets
items.zh: 修复了 `claude -p` 关于 claude.ai 登录已结束的警告，现在会说明 `claude auth logout` 也会移除已保存的 MCP 服务器登录和 plugin 密钥

items.en: Fixed Bash permission prompts offering "don't ask again" for commands that write to sensitive paths such as `.git` or `.claude`, where the saved rule did not stop the next prompt
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限提示对写入 `.git` 或 `.claude` 等敏感路径的命令提供“不再询问”选项的问题，此前保存的规则无法阻止下一次提示

items.en: Fixed a case where some `lsof` commands ran without a permission prompt
items.zh: 修复了某些 `lsof` 命令在没有权限提示的情况下运行的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash commands that write a file with `cat > file <<EOF` being shown as "Read 1 file"
items.zh: 修复了使用 `cat > file <<EOF` 写入文件的 Bash 命令被显示为“Read 1 file”的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged an `rm` from the wrong folder and skipped the dangerous-removal prompt under bypass permissions or a Bash allow rule
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查从错误文件夹判断 `rm`，并在绕过权限或 Bash 允许规则下跳过危险删除提示的问题

items.en: Fixed `--permission-mode auto` or a settings `defaultMode: auto` starting in a mode that could allow more when auto mode was unavailable. It now starts in Manual mode, which asks first
items.zh: 修复了 `--permission-mode auto` 或设置中的 `defaultMode: auto` 在自动模式不可用时以可能允许更多操作的权限模式启动的问题。现在会以 Manual 模式启动，先进行询问

items.en: Fixed plan files sometimes being written outside the project when `plansDirectory` is set; a write that can't be shown to stay inside the project is now refused
items.zh: 修复了设置 `plansDirectory` 时计划文件有时被写到项目之外的问题；无法确认写入保持在项目内的写入现在会被拒绝

items.en: Fixed a permission prompt when Claude read the output of its own background command or agent after entering a worktree
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 进入 worktree 后读取自身后台命令或 agent 输出时出现权限提示的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where Bash permission checks missed part of a command
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查遗漏命令部分内容的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox could switch off during a session
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 沙箱可能在 session 期间被关闭的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash allow rules with an attached wildcard, such as `Bash(ls*)`, skipping the permission prompt in some cases; a rule that names a variable, such as `Bash(NODE_ENV*)`, now asks
items.zh: 修复了带通配符的 Bash 允许规则（如 `Bash(ls*)`）在某些情况下跳过权限提示的问题；指定变量的规则（如 `Bash(NODE_ENV*)`）现在会询问

items.en: Fixed auto mode running behind a gateway at `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` on a model whose gateway name contains "haiku"; such a model, other than `claude-haiku-5-5`, is now refused, as Haiku 4.5 is
items.zh: 修复了自动模式在 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 网关后运行、且模型网关名称包含“haiku”时的问题；此类模型（`claude-haiku-5-5` 除外）现在会被拒绝，与 Haiku 4.5 一致

items.en: Fixed Bash deny and ask rules missing some commands run through `sudo`, `env` and similar wrappers
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 拒绝和询问规则遗漏通过 `sudo`、`env` 及类似包装器运行的某些命令的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash allow rules written with combined `sudo` flags skipping the permission prompt in some cases
items.zh: 修复了使用组合 `sudo` 标志编写的 Bash 允许规则在某些情况下跳过权限提示的问题

items.en: Fixed `sandbox.excludedCommands` letting a command that it does not name run outside the sandbox in some cases
items.zh: 修复了 `sandbox.excludedCommands` 在某些情况下允许其未指定的命令在沙箱外运行的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where the Write and Edit tools could write to a path covered by a `Read` deny rule
items.zh: 修复了 Write 和 Edit 工具可能写入被 `Read` 拒绝规则覆盖的路径的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where a Bash command ran without a permission prompt for zsh users with certain non-default shell options set
items.zh: 修复了设置了某些非默认 shell 选项的 zsh 用户执行 Bash 命令时未出现权限提示的问题

items.en: Fixed the Bash sandbox not fully protecting Claude Code's own config on installs still using the legacy config file
items.zh: 修复了在仍使用旧版配置文件的安装中，Bash 沙箱未能完全保护 Claude Code 自身配置的问题

items.en: Fixed a permission prompt from a mod's `tool.check` hook naming every plugin hooked on the tool instead of the one that asked
items.zh: 修复了 mod 的 `tool.check` hook 触发的权限提示会列出所有挂接到该工具上的 plugin，而不是只列出发起请求的那个 plugin 的问题

items.en: Fixed sandboxed commands being able to read Claude Code's file checkpoint copies under the config directory
items.zh: 修复了沙箱中的命令能够读取配置目录下 Claude Code 文件检查点副本的问题

items.en: Fixed a rewind sometimes changing your permission mode
items.zh: 修复了回退有时会改变权限模式的问题

items.en: Fixed project settings sometimes being read through a symbolic link that leads to a different folder than the one Claude Code checked
items.zh: 修复了项目设置有时会通过一个指向与 Claude Code 所检查目录不同的符号链接被读取的问题

items.en: Fixed HTTP hooks failing with HTTP 500 on Linux when `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` is set and `sandbox.enabled` is off
items.zh: 修复了在 Linux 上设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` 且 `sandbox.enabled` 关闭时，HTTP hooks 因 HTTP 500 失败的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude -p` and the Agent SDK running Bash unsandboxed when `--settings` or SDK settings that turn the sandbox on fail validation; Claude Code now stops at start-up and names the invalid setting
items.zh: 修复了当 `--settings` 或 SDK 设置中用于开启沙箱的配置未通过校验时，`claude -p` 和 Agent SDK 会在未启用沙箱的情况下运行 Bash 的问题；Claude Code 现在会在启动时停止并指出无效的设置项

items.en: Fixed `/export` silently stopping early after a long run of calls to an MCP tool that is no longer loaded
items.zh: 修复了在长时间连续调用一个已不再加载的 MCP 工具后，`/export` 会静默提前终止的问题

items.en: Fixed earlier MCP tool calls missing from a resumed conversation, and lines repeating in scrollback, when the server connects late
items.zh: 修复了服务器延迟连接时，恢复的对话中缺少此前的 MCP 工具调用，以及回滚缓冲区中出现重复行的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude mcp add --help` splitting long example commands across lines in narrow terminals and pipes, so a pasted example ran without its header
items.zh: 修复了 `claude mcp add --help` 在窄终端和管道中会把较长的示例命令折行，导致粘贴的示例缺少开头部分仍能运行的问题

items.en: Fixed plugins with `defaultEnabled: false` staying off in a claude.ai chat's cloud session after you turn them on in claude.ai
items.zh: 修复了在 claude.ai 中启用 `defaultEnabled: false` 的 plugins 后，它们在 claude.ai 聊天的云端 session 中仍保持关闭的问题

items.en: Fixed `/fast on` and `/fast off` on Vertex not asking a plugin's `config.set` hook, as the `/fast` menu does
items.zh: 修复了在 Vertex 上执行 `/fast on` 和 `/fast off` 时不会像 `/fast` 菜单那样询问 plugin 的 `config.set` hook 的问题

items.en: Fixed documents created through the Claude Docs connector not opening in your browser when you work in a terminal
items.zh: 修复了在终端中工作时，通过 Claude Docs connector 创建的文档无法在浏览器中打开的问题

items.en: Fixed the misleading "not cached" error for a plugin only a repository's settings enable: it now says it isn't installed, gives the install command, and shows in text and stream-json `-p` runs
items.zh: 修复了仅由仓库设置启用的 plugin 会报出误导性的“not cached”错误的问题：现在会提示该 plugin 未安装、给出安装命令，并在文本和 stream-json 的 `-p` 运行中显示

items.en: Fixed mods being able to reword Claude Code's own confirmation questions
items.zh: 修复了 mods 能够改写 Claude Code 自身确认问题措辞的问题

items.en: Fixed a mod's hot reload sometimes ignoring a file created just after a failed reload
items.zh: 修复了 mod 的热重载有时会忽略在重载失败后刚创建的文件的问题

items.en: Fixed marketplaces named `npm`, `pip`, `uv`, `cargo`, `github` or `gh` being refused as reserved names
items.zh: 修复了名为 `npm`、`pip`、`uv`、`cargo`、`github` 或 `gh` 的 marketplace 被当作保留名称拒绝的问题

items.en: Fixed a stopped MCP call, or a stopped shell command in fullscreen, reading as "Called" or "Ran" in a collapsed tool group: it now says no result was recorded and shows its input
items.zh: 修复了已停止的 MCP 调用或全屏模式下已停止的 shell 命令在折叠的工具组中显示为“Called”或“Ran”的问题：现在会说明未记录结果并显示其输入

items.en: Fixed load errors of plugins enabled by managed settings going only to the debug log in SDK and Desktop sessions: `init.plugin_errors` now lists them
items.zh: 修复了由托管设置启用的 plugins 的加载错误在 SDK 和 Desktop session 中仅写入调试日志的问题：现在 `init.plugin_errors` 会列出这些错误

items.en: Fixed plugin installs hiding what a plugin's install command wrote to stderr when that command succeeded, such as a note that the plugin has no skills yet
items.zh: 修复了插件安装成功时，插件安装命令写入 stderr 的内容被隐藏的问题，例如插件尚无 skill 的提示

items.en: Fixed one malformed entry in a plugin marketplace's `renames` map making Claude Code ignore the marketplace's other renames
items.zh: 修复了插件 marketplace 的 `renames` 映射中一个格式错误的条目会导致 Claude Code 忽略该 marketplace 其他重命名的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude --bg --safe-mode` sessions stopping at startup to ask about project MCP servers that safe mode never starts
items.zh: 修复了 `claude --bg --safe-mode` session 在启动时停下来询问项目 MCP 服务器的问题，而安全模式根本不会启动这些服务器

items.en: Fixed MCP link prompts offering Accept for non-http links without saying the link wouldn't open
items.zh: 修复了 MCP 链接提示对非 http 链接提供“接受”选项却未说明该链接不会打开的问题

items.en: Fixed `/mcp` and `/plugins` opening an MCP server's page with the cursor on "Disable" when the server needs authentication but still holds its sign-in; the page now offers "Reconnect" and opens on it
items.zh: 修复了当 MCP 服务器需要认证但仍保留登录状态时，`/mcp` 和 `/plugins` 打开该服务器页面时光标停在“禁用”上的问题；页面现在提供“重新连接”并默认选中该项

items.en: Fixed plugins with a version list in `enabledPlugins` staying off with no message: `/plugin` and `claude plugin list` now say why
items.zh: 修复了 `enabledPlugins` 中带有版本列表的插件保持关闭且无任何提示的问题：`/plugin` 和 `claude plugin list` 现在会说明原因

items.en: Fixed plugins and marketplaces failing to install on Windows when the path of a cloned file reaches 260 characters
items.zh: 修复了在 Windows 上克隆文件路径达到 260 个字符时插件和 marketplace 安装失败的问题

items.en: Fixed a Stop pressed right after sending a message showing as an error in remote and SDK sessions while a `UserPromptSubmit` or plugin prompt hook was still running
items.zh: 修复了在 `UserPromptSubmit` 或插件 prompt hook 仍在运行时，发送消息后立即按下停止在远程和 SDK session 中显示为错误的问题

items.en: Fixed an MCP server staying disconnected with no tools after an Agent SDK app or `claude -p` caller removed and re-added it, when a tool call had tried to reach it in between
items.zh: 修复了 Agent SDK 应用或 `claude -p` 调用方移除并重新添加 MCP 服务器后，若期间有工具调用尝试访问该服务器，则服务器保持断开且无工具的问题

items.en: Fixed text-output `claude -p` runs printing nothing to stderr when a `--plugin-dir` mod's hook hangs or crashes the hooks worker
items.zh: 修复了当 `--plugin-dir` mod 的 hook 挂起或导致 hooks worker 崩溃时，文本输出的 `claude -p` 运行不向 stderr 输出任何内容的问题

items.en: Fixed SDK sessions giving an MCP server named by `--allowedTools` or an `mcp_tool` hook less than 2s before the first turn when settings lowered `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` after start-up
items.zh: 修复了当设置在启动后降低 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` 时，SDK session 给 `--allowedTools` 或 `mcp_tool` hook 指定的 MCP 服务器在首轮之前不足 2 秒的问题

items.en: Fixed headless sessions ending when an SDK host sent a null entry in an MCP server's tools list
items.zh: 修复了 SDK 宿主在 MCP 服务器的工具列表中发送 null 条目时无头 session 结束的问题

items.en: Fixed WebFetch dropping empty table cells and shifting later values a column left
items.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 丢弃空表格单元格并导致后续值左移一列的问题

items.en: Fixed temporary files of a session that had changed directory being left behind when the session expired under `cleanupPeriodDays`
items.zh: 修复了已切换目录的 session 在 `cleanupPeriodDays` 下过期时其临时文件被遗留的问题

items.en: Fixed managed settings (`managed-settings.json`, `managed-settings.d`) sometimes being missed at start-up while another program was rewriting the file: start-up now reads such a file a second time
items.zh: 修复了托管设置（`managed-settings.json`、`managed-settings.d`）在启动时因其他程序正在重写文件而有时被遗漏的问题：启动时现在会再次读取此类文件

items.en: Fixed `.claude/settings.local.json` not being ignored globally when the folder became a git repository later, or on a new machine
items.zh: 修复了当文件夹后来成为 git 仓库或在新机器上时，`.claude/settings.local.json` 未被全局忽略的问题

items.en: Fixed `/diff` waiting for Claude to finish before closing the diff panel in fullscreen
items.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下 `/diff` 等待 Claude 完成才关闭 diff 面板的问题

items.en: Fixed `/memory` showing wrong or roundabout paths for folders whose names start with the working directory's or home folder's name, and losing slashes in the file path on Windows
items.zh: 修复了 `/memory` 对名称以工作目录或主目录名称开头的文件夹显示错误或绕弯路径的问题，以及 Windows 上文件路径丢失斜杠的问题

items.en: Fixed a broken emoji character in a tool call's parameter name being resent with later requests, which strict JSON parsers reject
items.zh: 修复了工具调用参数名中损坏的 emoji 字符会随后续请求重发并被严格 JSON 解析器拒绝的问题

items.en: Fixed a collapsed tool call looking as if it ran after you rejected it with a reason: it now shows "Not run · rejected"
items.zh: 修复了折叠的工具调用在你带原因拒绝后仍看起来像已运行的问题：现在显示“未运行 · 已拒绝”

items.en: Fixed a case where part of a saved session could be lost on NFS or FUSE file systems when Claude Code discarded a reply
items.zh: 修复了在 NFS 或 FUSE 文件系统上，Claude Code 丢弃一条回复时已保存 session 的部分内容可能丢失的问题

items.en: Fixed WebFetch not rechecking organization policy and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH` at each call
items.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 在每次调用时未重新检查组织策略和 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH` 的问题

items.en: Fixed file titles, app names and session names in @-mentions from claude.ai and the desktop app sometimes being treated as text you typed
items.zh: 修复了来自 claude.ai 和桌面应用的 @ 提及中的文件标题、应用名称和 session 名称有时被当作你输入的文本的问题

items.en: Fixed a multi-row status line being pushed off screen by a long prompt in the fullscreen renderer
items.zh: 修复了在全屏渲染器中，多行状态栏被过长的 prompt 挤出屏幕的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where certificate errors behind a TLS-inspecting proxy persisted when the proxy itself is reached over `https://`
items.zh: 修复了通过 `https://` 访问 TLS 检查代理本身时，代理后方的证书错误仍然存在的问题

items.en: Fixed Pro and Max accounts being offered feedback drafts that their organization would refuse
items.zh: 修复了 Pro 和 Max 账户被提供其组织会拒绝的反馈草稿的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome's policy message telling people to contact their admin when no admin setting can turn it on
items.zh: 修复了 Claude in Chrome 的策略消息在没有任何管理员设置可以启用它时，仍提示用户联系管理员的问题

items.en: Fixed the artifact preview sometimes opening a different artifact than the one Claude just published
items.zh: 修复了 artifact 预览有时打开的不是 Claude 刚刚发布的那个 artifact 的问题

items.en: Fixed certificate name-constraint errors being retried for minutes; they now fail at once with a message that says what to fix
items.zh: 修复了证书名称约束错误被重试数分钟的问题；现在会立即失败，并给出说明需要修复什么的消息

items.en: Fixed `claude --teleport` opening an empty session when the server could not find the session's history, and `claude -p --teleport` exiting without an error when the resume failed
items.zh: 修复了服务器找不到 session 历史时 `claude --teleport` 打开空 session 的问题，以及恢复失败时 `claude -p --teleport` 未报错就退出的问题

items.en: Fixed a misspelled keybinding modifier, such as `ctl+k`, binding the bare key; the binding is now ignored
items.zh: 修复了拼错的键位修饰符（如 `ctl+k`）会绑定裸键的问题；现在该绑定会被忽略

items.en: Fixed `/btw` answers and recaps sometimes including earlier replies from the conversation
items.zh: 修复了 `/btw` 的回答和回顾有时包含对话中更早回复的问题

items.en: Fixed start-up requests switching from an organization's managed proxy and CA settings to user-set ones when a read of the managed settings file failed
items.zh: 修复了读取托管设置文件失败时，启动请求从组织管理的代理和 CA 设置切换到用户设置的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude giving a wrong reason when a new message interrupted a file it was sending you
items.zh: 修复了新消息打断 Claude 正在发送给你的文件时，Claude 给出错误原因的问题

items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that a hook's `continue: false` had stopped
items.zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 重新执行已被 hook 的 `continue: false` 停止的轮次的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude being told that automatic model switching is off when safeguards stopped a subagent whose model had no other model to switch to
items.zh: 修复了保护机制停止一个模型没有其他模型可切换的 subagent 时，Claude 被告知自动模型切换已关闭的问题

items.en: Fixed the changed-files list of remote sessions leaving out files added with `git add -N` before the first commit
items.zh: 修复了远程 session 的已更改文件列表遗漏首次提交前用 `git add -N` 添加的文件的问题

items.en: Fixed some Claude in Chrome tool calls, such as `browser_batch`, not showing the tool's name in the fullscreen transcript (ctrl+o) or in a subagent's progress
items.zh: 修复了部分 Claude in Chrome 工具调用（如 `browser_batch`）在全屏记录（ctrl+o）或 subagent 进度中不显示工具名称的问题

items.en: Fixed subagent progress summaries skipping an update when the reply took between 10 and 20 seconds
items.zh: 修复了回复耗时在 10 到 20 秒之间时，subagent 进度摘要跳过更新的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude doctor` and `/status` saying a linked managed settings file is still read when it could not be read
items.zh: 修复了 `claude doctor` 和 `/status` 在链接的托管设置文件无法读取时仍显示其会被读取的问题

items.en: Fixed an interactive `--chrome` session giving no reason for starting without Claude in Chrome when your organization's policy turns it off: a line now says so
items.zh: 修复了交互式 `--chrome` 会话在组织策略关闭 Claude in Chrome 时启动却不说明原因的问题：现在会显示一行说明

items.en: Fixed the `/rewind` list on network paths and hung folders: it named every tracked file as changed, was slow to show labels, and showed none at all when a file read never returned
items.zh: 修复了网络路径和挂起文件夹上 `/rewind` 列表的问题：它曾把每个受跟踪文件都标记为已更改、标签显示缓慢，且在文件读取始终不返回时完全不显示

items.en: Fixed `--debug` and `--debug-file` replacing a file named `latest` in the debug log's folder
items.zh: 修复了 `--debug` 和 `--debug-file` 会替换调试日志文件夹中名为 `latest` 的文件的问题

items.en: Fixed a timed-out feedback send being reported as too large; it now says the request timed out
items.zh: 修复了反馈发送超时却被报告为内容过大的问题；现在会提示请求超时

items.en: Fixed screen reader mode cutting off an announcement when the system clock moved forward while it was being read
items.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式下，系统时钟在播报过程中向前跳变导致播报被截断的问题

items.en: Fixed screen reader mode dropping dictated or pasted text, and emoji, typed into an answer to a question or permission prompt
items.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式下，在回答提问或权限提示时输入的口述文本、粘贴文本和 emoji 被丢弃的问题

items.en: Fixed the name label under permission and plan dialogs hiding part of some agent names
items.zh: 修复了权限和计划对话框下方的名称标签遮挡部分 agent 名称的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where pressing Ctrl+C just as `claude update` finished removed the `claude` command
items.zh: 修复了在 `claude update` 刚完成时按 Ctrl+C 会导致 `claude` 命令被删除的问题

items.en: Fixed the fullscreen header naming the session's effort level for a viewed subagent on a different model, which that subagent doesn't use
items.zh: 修复了全屏标题栏在查看使用其他模型的 subagent 时显示该 session 的 effort 级别的问题，因为该 subagent 并不使用该级别

items.en: Fixed the model picker and `/model` showing a picked effort level that `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` overrides
items.zh: 修复了模型选择器和 `/model` 显示所选 effort 级别、但该级别会被 `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` 覆盖的问题

items.en: Fixed the tip after a slow worktree creation suggesting a `sparsePaths` list without `.claude`, which left worktrees without your project settings and rules
items.zh: 修复了 worktree 创建缓慢后的提示建议使用不含 `.claude` 的 `sparsePaths` 列表、导致 worktree 缺少项目设置和规则的问题

items.en: Fixed the newest model's highlight missing from the `/model` picker
items.zh: 修复了 `/model` 选择器中缺少最新模型高亮的问题

items.en: Fixed `/upgrade` and Ctrl+clicked links in fullscreen failing silently when no browser can open: the address is now shown
items.zh: 修复了全屏模式下 `/upgrade` 和 Ctrl+点击的链接在无浏览器可打开时静默失败的问题：现在会显示地址

items.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway's JSON logs escaping newlines and other control characters in a message twice
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用网关的 JSON 日志对消息中的换行符和其他控制字符重复转义的问题

items.en: Fixed terminal control sequences in a subagent's message taking effect instead of showing as plain text when the message is expanded
items.zh: 修复了展开 subagent 消息时，消息中的终端控制序列会生效而非以纯文本显示的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome setup saying `/chrome` finishes the connection; it now tells you to restart with `claude --chrome`
items.zh: 修复了 Claude in Chrome 设置提示称 `/chrome` 可完成连接的问题；现在会提示使用 `claude --chrome` 重启

items.en: Fixed the Option-key hint appearing while typing ø or π inside words on Danish, Norwegian, Faroese and Greek keyboard layouts
items.zh: 修复了在丹麦语、挪威语、法罗语和希腊语键盘布局下，在单词内输入 ø 或 π 时出现 Option 键提示的问题

items.en: Fixed a Claude Desktop session getting stuck as busy after another of your sessions sent it the same message twice or many messages at once
items.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop session 在另一个 session 向它重复发送同一条消息或同时发送多条消息后卡在忙碌状态的问题

items.en: Fixed long tool results staying on disk after a session run with `--no-session-persistence`; they are now removed on normal exit, Ctrl+C or SIGTERM
items.zh: 修复了使用 `--no-session-persistence` 运行的 session 结束后长工具结果仍留在磁盘上的问题；现在会在正常退出、Ctrl+C 或 SIGTERM 时将其删除

items.en: Fixed `PreCompact`, `PostCompact` and post-compaction `SessionStart` hooks not receiving `agent_id` and `agent_type` when a subagent compacts
items.zh: 修复了 subagent 执行上下文压缩时，`PreCompact`、`PostCompact` 和压缩后的 `SessionStart` hooks 未收到 `agent_id` 和 `agent_type` 的问题

items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when another process rewrote the file while it was being trimmed
items.zh: 修复 `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` 在裁剪已保存的 transcript 时，若另一进程同时重写该文件，会导致消息被丢弃的问题

items.en: Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice repeating or not showing past the weekly Fable limit when Claude Code made a quick side request on a smaller model, such as naming the session
items.zh: 修复当 Claude Code 在较小模型上发起快速附带请求（例如为 session 命名）时，“Now using usage credits”提示重复出现，或在超过每周 Fable 限额后不再显示的问题

items.en: Fixed Fable's weekly limit showing no reset time and no options menu in the terminal
items.zh: 修复 Fable 每周限额在终端中不显示重置时间和选项菜单的问题

items.en: Fixed a wait chosen in the usage limit menu silently moving to a later reset when its request was refused; the menu now opens
items.zh: 修复在用量限制菜单中选择的等待时间在请求被拒绝时静默改为更晚的重置时间的问题；现在会打开菜单

items.en: Fixed the spend limit menu offering a lower limit when your current limit couldn't be loaded
items.zh: 修复当前限额无法加载时，支出限额菜单仍提供更低限额的问题

items.en: Fixed `/usage` hiding limit bars for setup tokens and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`: it keeps the session and weekly bars and says why the rest are missing
items.zh: 修复 `/usage` 对 setup token 和 `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` 隐藏限额条的问题：现在会保留 session 和每周限额条，并说明其余限额条缺失的原因

items.en: Fixed `/usage` showing a whole-session percentage beside a subagent type's name, and saying sessions ran 8 hours when it only counts hours with requests
items.zh: 修复 `/usage` 在 subagent 类型名称旁显示整个 session 的百分比，以及仅统计有请求的小时数却显示 session 运行了 8 小时的问题

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed sessions showing as disconnected for a minute or more after a network change such as switching Wi-Fi or reconnecting a VPN
items.zh: Remote Control：修复网络变化（如切换 Wi-Fi 或重连 VPN）后，session 显示为断开连接长达一分钟或更久的问题

items.en: Fixed Remote Control showing nothing while Claude Code asks whether to use usage credits: the question now also shows in the Claude app
items.zh: 修复 Claude Code 询问是否使用用量额度时 Remote Control 不显示任何内容的问题：该问题现在也会在 Claude 应用中显示

items.en: Fixed Remote Control showing a session as running while it waited on a permission prompt that can only be answered in the terminal
items.zh: 修复 Remote Control 在 session 等待只能在终端中回答的权限提示时仍显示为运行中的问题

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed `claude remote-control` reconnecting as a new computer when restarted in the same folder more than 4 hours after it stopped; it now keeps its identity for up to 30 days
items.zh: Remote Control：修复 `claude remote-control` 在同一文件夹中停止运行超过 4 小时后重启时被识别为新计算机的问题；现在其身份最多可保留 30 天

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed sessions left running at shutdown, and finished sessions holding their slot, when the disk stops responding
items.zh: Remote Control：修复磁盘无响应时，关闭时仍有 session 在运行，以及已结束的 session 仍占用其槽位的问题

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed other devices and phone notifications not showing what Claude is asking permission for when `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK` is set
items.zh: Remote Control：修复设置 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 或 `DO_NOT_TRACK` 时，其他设备和手机通知不显示 Claude 正在请求何种权限的问题

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed the host exiting, or stopping reading a session's output, in verbose or debug mode when a tool call's `command` was a number, boolean or object
items.zh: Remote Control：修复在 verbose 或 debug 模式下，当工具调用的 `command` 为数字、布尔值或对象时，宿主退出或停止读取 session 输出的问题

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed a host that could stall after sessions failed to start in folders on a filesystem that had stopped responding
items.zh: Remote Control：修复在已停止响应的文件系统上的文件夹中启动 session 失败后，宿主可能卡住的问题

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed sessions from the desktop app showing as idle on your phone while background subagents were still running
items.zh: Remote Control：修复来自桌面应用的 session 在后台 subagent 仍在运行时，在手机上显示为空闲的问题

items.en: Fixed the Agent SDK's `managedSettings` ignoring the Remote Control, agent view, Workflows and Artifact off switches
items.zh: 修复 Agent SDK 的 `managedSettings` 忽略 Remote Control、agent 视图、Workflows 和 Artifact 关闭开关的问题

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry export failing silently when an `otlp` exporter had an endpoint but no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL`: it now defaults to `http/protobuf`
items.zh: 修复当 `otlp` exporter 配置了 endpoint 但未设置 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` 时，OpenTelemetry 导出静默失败的问题：现在默认使用 `http/protobuf`

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry export to the default `localhost:4318` endpoint going through a configured proxy
items.zh: 修复导出到默认 `localhost:4318` endpoint 的 OpenTelemetry 数据经过已配置代理的问题

items.en: Fixed one malformed `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` entry dropping all of that variable's attributes from the OpenTelemetry resource; the others are now kept, and `/status` names the one left off
items.zh: 修复一个格式错误的 `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` 条目导致该变量的所有属性从 OpenTelemetry 资源中被丢弃的问题；现在会保留其余属性，并由 `/status` 指出被省略的那一项

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` events and interaction spans recording a background agent's reply when `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0`
items.zh: 修复了当 `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0` 时，OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` 事件和交互 span 记录后台 agent 回复的问题

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry exports failing when a proxy took over 10 seconds to reach the collector; it now has 25 seconds, also the most that `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` can allow (previously 30)
items.zh: 修复了代理连接 collector 耗时超过 10 秒时 OpenTelemetry 导出失败的问题；现在超时时间为 25 秒，这也是 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` 允许的最大值（此前为 30）

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry `agent.name` showing a user-defined subagent's name instead of `custom` when an official plugin's skill launched it
items.zh: 修复了当官方 plugin 的 skill 启动用户自定义 subagent 时，OpenTelemetry `agent.name` 显示该 subagent 的名称而非 `custom` 的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude agents` showing a status from an earlier turn after a session resumes
items.zh: 修复了 session 恢复后 `claude agents` 显示上一轮状态的问题

items.en: Fixed read-only git commands needing approval, or being refused under `claude -p`, when `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` is set on Linux
items.zh: 修复了在 Linux 上设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` 时，只读 git 命令需要审批或在 `claude -p` 下被拒绝的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude agents` losing a typed prompt: Esc now needs a second press to clear it, and ctrl+y restores it
items.zh: 修复了 `claude agents` 丢失已输入 prompt 的问题：现在 Esc 需要按第二次才会清除，ctrl+y 可恢复

items.en: Fixed the move-to-background key doing nothing in `claude attach` and `claude agents` sessions; to detach with Ctrl+B d, press d within 800 ms of Ctrl+B
items.zh: 修复了在 `claude attach` 和 `claude agents` session 中移到后台快捷键无效的问题；如需用 Ctrl+B d 分离，请在按下 Ctrl+B 后 800 毫秒内按 d

items.en: Fixed background sessions ignoring a `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING` set only in your shell when the background service started without it
items.zh: 修复了后台服务启动时未设置 `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING` 时，后台 session 忽略仅在 shell 中设置的该变量的问题

items.en: Fixed false "needs input" notifications in `claude agents` after replying to a blocked session, and repeated ones after a background turn ended with no text and only basic tools such as Bash or Read
items.zh: 修复了在 `claude agents` 中回复被阻塞的 session 后出现错误的“需要输入”通知，以及后台回合结束时没有文本、仅使用 Bash 或 Read 等基础工具后重复出现该通知的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude -p` silently using another model in text output when settings block the requested one; it now warns on stderr
items.zh: 修复了当设置阻止使用所请求的模型时，`claude -p` 在文本输出中静默改用其他模型的问题；现在会在 stderr 上发出警告

items.en: Fixed `claude -p` printing notes about `deniedModels` and `availableModels` entries on every run; `/status` and `claude doctor` still list them
items.zh: 修复了 `claude -p` 每次运行都打印关于 `deniedModels` 和 `availableModels` 条目的提示的问题；`/status` 和 `claude doctor` 仍会列出这些条目

items.en: Windows: Fixed some file-reading Bash commands running without a permission prompt when given a wildcard or a list of files
items.zh: Windows：修复了某些读取文件的 Bash 命令在传入通配符或文件列表时无需权限提示即可运行的问题

items.en: Windows: Fixed Claude Code running a `.cmd` or `.bat` wrapper found beside a program's `.exe` in the same PATH folder (a `git.cmd` next to `git.exe`, say); it now runs the `.exe`, as `cmd.exe` would
items.zh: Windows：修复了 Claude Code 运行与程序 `.exe` 位于同一 PATH 文件夹旁的 `.cmd` 或 `.bat` 包装脚本的问题（例如 `git.exe` 旁的 `git.cmd`）；现在会像 `cmd.exe` 那样运行 `.exe`

items.en: Windows: Fixed shell commands failing with "Working directory was deleted" on drives where a folder's real path can't be resolved
items.zh: Windows：修复了在无法解析文件夹真实路径的驱动器上，shell 命令因“工作目录已被删除”而失败的问题

items.en: Fixed a cloud session's history becoming unreadable if its machine stopped just after the history was rewritten
items.zh: 修复了云 session 的历史记录在重写后其机器立即停止时变得无法读取的问题

items.en: Fixed scheduled tasks from an ended session sometimes not running after another session in the same folder used `/clear`, `/resume` or `/branch`
items.zh: 修复了已结束 session 的定时任务在同一文件夹中的另一 session 使用 `/clear`、`/resume` 或 `/branch` 后有时不运行的问题

items.en: Fixed an approved plan being answered with "You are not in plan mode" when the approval arrived after the session's process had restarted, in cloud, self-hosted runner and SDK sessions
items.zh: 修复了在云、自托管运行器和 SDK session 中，当审批在 session 进程重启后到达时，已批准的 plan 被回复“你不在 plan 模式”的问题

items.en: Cloud sessions: Fixed an answer to Claude's question being lost after a restart in a long conversation
items.zh: 云 session：修复了长对话中重启后对 Claude 提问的回答丢失的问题

items.en: Fixed a message dropping out of a cloud session's conversation when the session restarted before Claude replied
items.zh: 修复了当 session 在 Claude 回复前重启时，消息从云 session 对话中丢失的问题

items.en: Cloud sessions: Fixed Claude saying an attached image is missing when the message names its file
items.zh: 云 session：修复了当消息指明所附图片的文件名时，Claude 却称该图片缺失的问题

items.en: Fixed a resumed cloud session making a model call nobody asked for when files arrived right after a chat's first reply
items.zh: 修复了恢复的云 session 在聊天首次回复后立即收到文件时发起无谓模型调用的问题

items.en: Fixed streamed replies in cloud sessions missing text from the middle when the session's container shut down partway through a reply
items.zh: 修复了云 session 中流式回复在 session 容器于回复中途关闭时丢失中间文本的问题

items.en: Fixed skill files sent from Cowork cloud sessions sometimes failing to upload on the first try
items.zh: 修复了从 Cowork 云 session 发送的 skill 文件有时首次上传失败的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a response that was discarded because its tool call could not be parsed still showing after Claude retried
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复因工具调用无法解析而被丢弃的响应在 Claude 重试后仍会显示的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a queued message missing from a conversation or fork when it directly followed a compaction summary
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了紧跟在上下文压缩摘要之后的排队消息在对话或分叉中缺失的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the "Buy usage credits on claude.ai" button counting as agreement to pay for Fable while usage credits were off
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在用量额度关闭时，“在 claude.ai 上购买用量额度”按钮被计为同意为 Fable 付费的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the "extensions want to relaunch the terminal" warning coming back on open terminals after every window reload or restart
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了每次窗口重新加载或重启后，已打开的终端上再次出现“扩展想要重新启动终端”警告的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed "Couldn't load this conversation's saved history" appearing in a new chat whose Claude process had restarted before the first prompt
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在首个 prompt 之前 Claude 进程已重启的新聊天中显示“无法加载此对话的已保存历史记录”的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen showing the login choices again after a pasted code; it now shows "Signing in…" until the sign-in finishes
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了粘贴验证码后登录界面再次显示登录选项的问题；现在会显示“正在登录…”直到登录完成

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the "You've hit your Fable limit" line staying in the VS Code and JetBrains panels after you pick another model
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了选择其他模型后，VS Code 和 JetBrains 面板中仍保留“你已达到 Fable 用量限制”提示的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the Fable usage warning in the VS Code and JetBrains panels naming usage credits when they're off or used up
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 VS Code 和 JetBrains 面板中的 Fable 用量警告在用量额度关闭或已用尽时仍提及用量额度的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the diff tab not opening for multi-line edits on files with CRLF line endings
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了对使用 CRLF 换行符的文件进行多行编辑时差异标签页不打开的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed dictation continuing to record after switching sessions
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了切换 session 后听写仍在继续录制的问题

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed self-hosted sessions staying on "Starting Claude Code" after it had started, when you reopened a paused session without sending a message
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了在不发送消息的情况下重新打开已暂停的 session 时，自托管 session 在启动后仍停留在“正在启动 Claude Code”的问题

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a paused session in a self-hosted environment sometimes still showing "Sending" and a Stop button under the "Session paused" banner
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了自托管环境中已暂停的 session 有时在“Session 已暂停”横幅下仍显示“正在发送”和停止按钮的问题

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed pull request updates from GitHub Enterprise Server linking to github.com in cloud sessions; new updates link to your own server
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了云 session 中来自 GitHub Enterprise Server 的拉取请求更新链接到 github.com 的问题；新更新现在链接到你自己的服务器

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed very large GitHub Actions job logs and run log archives failing to download or being cut off in cloud sessions
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了云 session 中非常大的 GitHub Actions 任务日志和运行日志归档无法下载或被截断的问题

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed new cloud sessions started from the iOS app with a repository not getting a branch of their own
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了从 iOS 应用启动并指定仓库的新云 session 未获得独立分支的问题

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed an open cloud or Remote Control session's page staying "Disconnected" after a few minutes of failed connections; it now tries to reconnect by itself
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了已打开的云 session 或远程控制 session 页面在连接失败几分钟后仍停留在“已断开连接”的问题；现在会自动尝试重新连接

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed Try again on an open cloud or Remote Control session's "Connection lost" card sending "Try again" as your message; it now tries to reconnect instead
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了在已打开的云 session 或远程控制 session 的“连接已丢失”卡片上点击“重试”时，将“重试”作为你的消息发送的问题；现在会改为尝试重新连接

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed the Stop button disappearing from a cloud session five minutes into a reply that had shown nothing yet while Claude was still working
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了云 session 中回复已进行五分钟且尚未显示任何内容、但 Claude 仍在工作时停止按钮消失的问题

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed an approval prompt sometimes disappearing from a tab left open after a self-hosted runner released the session while it waited for your answer
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了自托管运行器在等待你的回答期间释放 session 后，保持打开的标签页中审批提示有时消失的问题

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed removing a repository from a scheduled task silently moving its GitHub trigger to another repository; Save now waits until you pick one
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了从计划任务中移除仓库会悄悄将其 GitHub 触发器移到另一个仓库的问题；现在保存会等待你选择一个仓库

items.en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed git clones and fetches that take longer than ten minutes in a cloud session sometimes being cut off at the very end
items.zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了云 session 中耗时超过十分钟的 git clone 和 fetch 有时在最后阶段被中断的问题

items.en: \[Remote Control] Fixed your own session saying its environment was deleted when you deleted nothing; it now says your computer is no longer connected
items.zh: \[远程控制] 修复了未删除任何内容时，自己的 session 却提示其环境已被删除的问题；现在会提示你的计算机已断开连接

items.en: \[Remote Control] Fixed some sessions still showing as running in the session list after the computer disconnected before Claude started; they now show an error mark or as idle
items.zh: \[远程控制] 修复了在 Claude 启动前计算机已断开连接时，部分 session 仍在 session 列表中显示为运行中的问题；现在会显示错误标记或空闲状态

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled tasks in a Slack channel moved between Enterprise Grid workspaces failing to use Slack until someone posted there
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了在 Enterprise Grid 工作区之间迁移的 Slack 频道中，定时任务在有人于该频道发帖之前无法使用 Slack 的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed the Approve and post card in a DM with Claude appearing for private or Slack Connect channels, where Claude can't post; Claude now gets the reason and shows no card
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了在与 Claude 的私信中，批准并发布卡片会出现在 Claude 无法发帖的私有频道或 Slack Connect 频道中的问题；现在 Claude 会获知原因且不显示该卡片

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Remove connector in Claude Tag admin settings being refused when access bundles also held its credentials; it now removes those set on the connector and leaves the bundles' own
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了当访问捆绑包也持有 connector 的凭据时，Claude Tag 管理设置中的移除 connector 操作被拒绝的问题；现在会移除在 connector 上设置的凭据，并保留捆绑包自身的凭据

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed the Channels tab in Claude Tag admin settings splitting a workspace from its channels across pages; channels now appear right under their workspace
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 Claude Tag 管理设置中的频道标签页将工作区与其频道拆分到不同页面的问题；现在频道会直接显示在其工作区下方

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed the Set for Claude Tag link on the Cloud environments admin page not leading to the environment setting; it now opens the Slack page's Advanced tab, where you set it
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了云环境管理页面上的“为 Claude Tag 设置”链接未跳转到环境设置的问题；现在会打开 Slack 页面的“高级”标签页，即设置该环境的位置

summary.tldr: 新增实验性 Code Mode 与插件版本约束，强化沙箱与权限检查，修复大量登录、MCP 与云会话问题。

highlights.title: 新增实验性 Code Mode
highlights.detail: 需主动启用，启用后 Claude 通过编写 JavaScript 调用工具，可参考文档了解启用方式或为组织关闭。

highlights.title: 插件可声明版本范围
highlights.detail: plugin.json 支持 engines["claude-code"]，超出范围的插件不会被安装、更新或加载，安装时自动选符合范围的最新版本。

highlights.title: 未知模型上下文窗口改为 1M
highlights.detail: 无法识别的模型 ID 默认按 1M 上下文处理；在其他厂商的小窗口模型上可能每轮失败，需提前压缩或关闭 1M。
highlights.action: 若使用第三方小窗口模型，请在填满前设置 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 保持 200K。

highlights.title: 代理设置需改用 HTTPS_PROXY
highlights.detail: 组织设置和策略请求不再使用仅由 ALL_PROXY 配置的代理，依赖代理的网络可能无法获取策略。
highlights.action: 为组织设置和策略请求设置 HTTPS_PROXY。

highlights.title: 沙箱与权限检查加固
highlights.detail: 修复多处权限绕过：通配符允许规则、sudo/env 包装命令、符号链接写权限、Read 拒绝规则被 Write/Edit 绕过等。

highlights.title: 移除 subagentStatusLine 设置
highlights.detail: 该设置已移除，subagent 行固定使用默认外观；仍保留该键的设置文件可正常加载，不会报错。
